tables_1.title: (a) Are all movable/hinged structures like hatches and doors bonded with Type I Bond Straps (i.e. bond straps that are welded on both sides)?

fields_2.name: q1b
fields_2.label: (b) Are all type I bond straps free from rust & corrosion?

tables_2.title: (c) Are all removable/collapsible structures like stanchions/ladders/guard rails bonded to the deck using type II bonds (i.e. those bonds that are welded on one side and bolted on the other)?

fields_3.name: q1d
fields_3.label: (d) Are all type II bond straps free of rust and corrosion?

tables_3.title: (e) Have all metallic boxes like stowage boxes on the top deck been bonded to the deck?
(f) Are all unscreened cables running on the top deck routed through metallic conduits/wire way trunks?
(g) Have the cable screens/conduits been bonded 360 degrees at their point of penetration into the bulk head/deck head?

(h) If MCT glands have been used for entry of upper deck cables into below deck areas or superstructure, are the MCT glands 'EMI resistant', and have the cable screens been grounded at the point of entry?
(j) Are clips, bottle screw, swivel eyes, shackles, links etc. free from rust and are bonded with type II bonds?
(k) Are halyards/out hauls of wire ropes neatly coiled and the wire ropes bonded to structure near the cleat?
